title: Sumerian god who emerged from the water and taught civilization

tellings.quote: the Sumerian myths, right? So, here is a god who lands in the river, you know, outside of Sumer and comes up out of a vehicle of some kind

plain: A writer named Peter Levenda, on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, points to the myths of Sumer, one of the earliest civilisations, in what is now Iraq. He describes them as telling of a god who landed in the river outside Sumer, came up out of some kind of vehicle, and taught people the arts of civilisation, which, read his way, would mean non-human visitors helped start human society.
